title: Goldthorn
wikitext:
'''Goldthorn''' is an [[herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]]. The plant can be found on top of small hills.

==Pickable zones==
*[[Stranglethorn Vale]]	30.7%
*[[Arathi Highlands]]	19.2%
*[[Swamp of Sorrows]]	9.5%
*[[Alterac Mountains]]	8.4%
*[[Badlands]]	7.6%
*[[Feralas]]	7.3%
*[[Hinterlands]]	6.5%
*[[Scarlet Monastery]]	5.3%
*[[Dustwallow Marsh]]	2.9%
*[[Razorfen Downs]]	1.3%
*[[Azshara]]	1.2%
